start_daemon() {
    local f base pidfile user group
    f="$(unit_file "$1")"
    base="$(daemon_base "$1")"
    pidfile="/run/qisutu/$base.pid"
    daemon_running "$1" && return 0
    user="$(sed -n 's/^User=//p' "$f")"
    group="$(sed -n 's/^Group=//p' "$f")"
    [ -n "$user" ] || user="qisutu"
    local execstart=()
    read -ra execstart <<< "$(sed -n 's/^ExecStart=//p' "$f")"
    setsid runuser -u "$user" -g "$group" -- "${execstart[@]}" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 &
    echo $! >"$pidfile"
    sleep 1
    daemon_running "$1"
}
